data.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

Write RED structural tests for the completion-verifier.md Closure Checks section reading instructions. These tests fail until T4 adds Step 2.5 to the agent.

## Test File
Append to `tests/agents/test-closure-checks-s2.sh` (created in T1), or create a second test group within the same file.

The tests assert that `plugins/dso/agents/completion-verifier.md` contains:
1. The phrase "## Closure Checks" (section name the agent reads from ticket bodies)
2. The word "backward" OR "backward-compat" (backward compatibility rule documented)
3. The phrase "no section" OR "absent" combined with "pass" (absence = pass rule)
4. A reference to "Step 2.5" or a new named step for Closure Checks reading (before Step 3 SC evaluation)
5. The phrase "one-shot" (Closure Checks are evaluated one-shot, not persistent)

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: completion-verifier.md reads ## Closure Checks section (test for instruction presence)

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Tests added to `tests/agents/test-closure-checks-s2.sh`
2. Running `bash tests/agents/test-closure-checks-s2.sh` includes the new test cases and they fail (RED — Step 2.5 not yet in completion-verifier.md)
3. Test labels follow the pattern: `test_verifier_<behavior>: <assertion>`

## Verify Command
bash tests/agents/test-closure-checks-s2.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "FAIL|PASS|--- test_"
data.title: RED: test completion-verifier.md contains Closure Checks section reading and backward-compat rule
